item.title: Dream opening for divers in Antarctica
item.description: Some scuba divers dream of escaping to work in lands of warm sea and sunshine, with underwater experiences on tap every day. A smaller number of confirmed coldwater divers imagine themselves enjoying regular under-ice experiences in the polar regions. The opportunity to make that reality has arrived with a new British Antarctic Survey (BAS) recruitment drive. […]

item.description: Snorkel with basking sharks off Ireland’s Blasket Islands and discover why these gentle giants return each spring.
